title: Major Boruto Character Upgrade Teased in New Two Blue Vortex Chapter 35 Preview
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 35 is set to be the next installment of the manga and is only a few days away from release. Ahead of its arrival, a preview has been teased, and while it doesn’t confirm anything, it may have hinted at a training arc for a major Boruto character, which would be a natural development…
author: ComicBook

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Movie Reveals Main Trailer
content: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend movie revealed a main trailer on Monday. It is set to premiere in Japanese theaters on October 16. The upcoming movie is a sequel to Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus, which concluded in September 2025. CloverWorks returns to animate the conclusion to the series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ameku M.D.'s Mikito Chinen Launches New Manga
content: Mikito Chinen launched a new series with artist Kiyo Hasui on Kadokawa 's ComicWalker platform titled Prometheus Taisen (Prometheus War) on Wednesday. The story is set in the year 2045, after a calamity has struck humanity.
author: ANN

title: Jun Nishikawa's Maken no Deshi wa Munō de Saikyō! Manga Adaptation Ends
content: Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform published the final chapter of Jun Nishikawa 's manga adaptation of Sametarō Fukada 's Maken no Deshi wa Munō de Saikyō! Eiyū-ryū no Shugyō de Bannō ni Naretanode, Saikyō o Mezashimasu (The Demon Sword Disciple is Incompetent and the Strongest!
author: ANN

title: SuBLime Licenses 2 New Manga for Physical, Digital Release
content: Viz Media 's SuBLime imprint for boys-love manga announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday that it has licensed Mayuharu's Bursting with Love manga, and Fumi Tsuyuhisa 's Palace of the Omega: A Snowflower's Tale manga for English digital and physical release in early 2027.
author: ANN

title: Splatoon Raiders Game Gets Manga on July 15
content: The July issue of Shogakukan 's Coro Coro Comics magazine revealed on Monday that Splatoon Raiders , a new single-player spinoff game in its Splatoon series, will get a manga in the magazine's next issue on July 15.
author: ANN

title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo for Fall 2026
content: • The official website of the Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2 ( Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 ) television anime revealed the new staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Monday. The anime series adapting Buncololi 's comedy fantasy light novel is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BLEACH Unveils Final "THE STORIES" Visual as Thousand-Year Blood War Retrospective Begins
content: The ongoing TV ANIMATION BLEACH THE STORIES retrospective project has officially entered the Thousand-Year Blood War arc, with a fifth and final special visual released ahead of the anime’s return later this year . You can see the new visual below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sasaki and Peeps 2nd Season Anime Reveals October Debut, More Returning Staff in New Promo Video
content: Kadokawa revealed on Monday a new promotional video, new visual, additional returning staff members, and the October debut for the second season of the television anime of writer Buncololi and illustrator Kantoku 's Sasaki and Peeps ( Sasaki and Pichan ) novels.
author: ANN

title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 Reveals New Trailer and Visual, Different Director & Main Staff
content: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 has revealed a new key visual and trailer for the anime, along with confirming an October 2026 release date. Season 2 will feature some notable staff changes. Yushi Ibe has been appointed director, with Yamato Ochi serving as assistant director.
author: Anime Corner
